finding.claim: Embed HTML returned by the adapter is emitted raw, so html_input=escape or strip does not stop script injection from embeds. Verdict: PLAUSIBLE (depends on embed/embed returning attacker-chosen oEmbed html, which is not vendored here).
finding.source: Attacker-controlled Markdown: a standalone line https://attacker.example/x at top level. Precondition: integrator configured an embed.adapter (no default); allowed_domains empty by default allows any https host.
finding.sink: src/Extension/Embed/EmbedRenderer.php:33 returns getEmbedCode() as raw HTML with no HtmlFilter.

trace.note: Accepts any line beginning with https:// that is a bare link destination.
Top-level embeds collected and passed to adapter->updateEmbeds().
Remote fetch; code->html stored unmodified via setEmbedCode.
Raw output. No HtmlFilter call, unlike HtmlInlineRenderer.php:44 and HtmlBlockRenderer.php:44.

finding.guards_checked: (1) html_input applies only to html_inline and html_block renderers. (2) DisallowedRawHtml is a tag denylist and does not wrap the Embed renderer. (3) DomainFilteringAdapter restricts host only, not returned HTML. (4) EmbedProcessor fetches only top-level embeds. (5) Embed.php:46 setEmbedCode does no sanitization. Not ruled out: whether embed/embed returns attacker-chosen html from an attacker-hosted oEmbed endpoint.

finding.claim: The embed domain allowlist checks only the initial URL; the fetch is done by a separate client that may follow redirects to internal or metadata addresses (SSRF). Verdict: PLAUSIBLE (library redirect behavior unverified; library not vendored).
finding.source: Attacker-controlled Markdown embed URL. Preconditions: OscaroteroEmbedAdapter used with empty allowed_domains (default), or an allowlisted domain the attacker can redirect through (open redirect, attacker-controlled subdomain of an allowlisted suffix, shared hosting).
finding.sink: Server-side HTTP GET via EmbedLib::getMulti() at src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43.

trace.note: DomainFilteringAdapter wraps adapter only when allowed_domains is non-empty.
parse_url host suffix match on the original URL only.
Fetch. Redirect policy, private-IP blocking and DNS pinning unverified; none present in this repo.

finding.guards_checked: (1) https-only at EmbedStartParser.php:34 and DomainFilteringAdapter.php:47. (2) Suffix match at :55 uses a dot boundary, so evilallowed.com does not match. (3) Trailing-dot normalization at :52. (4) Parser differential ruled out: CommonMark unescapes backslash, but UrlEncoder.php:26 percent-encodes backslash (%5C) and other authority-relevant characters. (5) No private-IP blocklist or redirect policy in this repo; library not vendored.
